subject: JaxBARF resourcing + Corpus dependency
body: Lucia — resourcing and dependencies. People: Vera 50% (training + parity runs), Csilla 40% (pose-robustness study), Kaia 30% (evaluation + partner-capture curation). Compute: light — sequential per-scene training on titan best-effort; the full Blender set retrains overnight on 8 GPUs. The dependency that actually shapes our calendar is data: partner captures live in Corpus, and the v2 migration freeze bounds when we can land new capture collections. Jun's team confirmed the Corpus v2 freeze lands on 2026-07-24, so we're planning the partner-capture backfill around a July 24 freeze — meaning our May window is comfortably clear, and even the stretch follow-on ingestion in early July fits before the freeze. Kaia will batch the capture uploads in two tranches (April 6, April 27) regardless, to keep the robustness study fed. — Bruno
